text: It is almost never given on the spot :) It can depend on a lot of things, including how well you did in the interview, PIBA's general impression of whether the relationship is genuine and stable, and also just the seniority of the clerk (junior clerks may have to have their decisions checked by higher ups etc.). A couple of weeks is very, very normal. In edge cases, I have seen it take up to six months - but this is rare.
